info.title: NAE_Baseline
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

algorithm.description: The algorithm used in the NAE baseline. 'max':                this algorithm uses the max over a period of time                       to calculate the high theshold. 'standard_deviation': this algorithm uses the standard deviation                       to calculate the high threshold.

continuous_learning_window.description: The time (in seconds) is the moving window used to smooth the data. It is also the interval after which the thresholds are recalculated.

high.description: If present, defines the high threshold that is used during the 'learning' state.

low.description: If present, defines the low threshold that is used during the 'learning' state.

high_threshold_factor.description: Calculates the high threshold and depends on the algorithm chosen in the NAE baseline definition.

initial_learning_time.description: The time (in seconds) during which NAE calculates the high and low thresholds of the baseline.

learning_end_time.description: Time (in seconds from Epoch) when learning ended.

low_threshold_factor.description: Calculate the low threshold and depends on the algorithm chosen in the NAE baseline definition

nae_monitor.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Monitor](#/NAE_Monitor)
Reference to the NAE Monitor that this baseline is tracking

name.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Baseline](#/NAE_Baseline)
Baselines created by the particular NAE Agent.

state.description: The state of the baseline is:  'learning': the thresholds are still not finalized. Alerts will not be generated. 'active':   the baseline is operational and alerts will be generated as needed. 'inactive': the baseline is suspended. It generally happens when the agent is disabled.

high.description: High boundary of the baseline. Present only if the status is active.

low.description: Low boundary of the baseline. Present only if the status is active.

title.description: Custom title of the NAE Baseline.

title_arguments.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Parameter](#/NAE_Parameter)
References to the NAE Parameters used as arguments in the custom title of a NAE Baseline. The map key contains a position on the custom title and the map value contains the parameter name of the argument in that position.

parameters.name: NAE_Script.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Script](#/NAE_Script)
Name of a NAE Script. This has to be a valid canonical name (CNAME) (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor).

parameters.name: NAE_Agent.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Agent](#/NAE_Agent)
Name of a NAE Agent. This has to be a CNAME starting with NAE Script name followed by its own name (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor.agent1).

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
